name: acae-portfolio-public

interface.longDescription: Explore Anthony Clarke's ACAE motion-design portfolio to find creative references for a project. Search published 3D, AI, broadcast and motion-design work, inspect real portfolio images and videos in a gallery, learn about published services, and prepare an editable project-enquiry draft. Work labels come from the published portfolio. Enquiries remain unsent; the plugin does not book work or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Find ACAE work relevant to a 3D product launch.
Show me a gallery of ACAE AI-motion work.
Draft an enquiry for a short motion-design project; do not send it.
